audit_type: independent targeted eight-paper extraction quality audit
reviewer_role: source_audit; separate from MoE/serving extraction authors
main_finding: Headline numeric results checked are supported; exact source attribution, section/figure locators and percentage-point distinctions needed corrections. MegaBlocks prior corrections verified.
uncertainty_caution: Request quantiles, mean of repetitions, and cross-configuration standard deviations are not independent-workload confidence intervals. Absence claims here are limited to inspected sections.

Up to40% over best Tutel settings, and1.8–2.4× versus dense Megatron at comparable validation loss are distinct comparisons. No appendices in retrieved manuscript.
